Shining a Light on Risk: Risk Preferences and Adoption Decisions of Residential Solar PV
abstract: Individuals making a decision about whether to adopt green energy technology face significant financial risk, including technology underperformance, unexpected maintenance and repairs, and changes in policy regarding state and federal incentives. The presence of high risk in the adoption decision implies that individuals with a higher level of risk tolerance are more likely to adopt the technology than those who are risk averse. Additionally, early adopters who face more volatile financial returns are more likely to be risk-tolerant than late adopters. In this paper, we conduct a lab-in-the-field experiment to elicit individual risk preferences from a subject pool comprising of solar PV adopters and non-adopters, and use this data to examine the effect of risk preferences on the decision to adopt solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. Our findings confirm our hypothesis that risk preference plays a crucial role in determining the status of solar PV adoption and the timing of adoption. Our findings suggest that reducing risk in policy design or through risk-mitigating insurance products can help to broaden solar PV adoption among households.
abstract_zh: 个人在决定是否采用绿色能源技术时，面临着重大的财务风险，包括技术表现不佳、意外的维护和维修，以及州和联邦激励政策的变化。采用决策中存在的高风险意味着，风险承受能力较高的个人比风险厌恶者更有可能采用该技术。此外，面临更大收益波动的早期采用者，比晚期采用者更倾向于风险承受。在本文中，我们开展了一项现场实验室实验（lab-in-the-field experiment），以从一个由太阳能光伏采用者和非采用者组成的受试者群体中，引出个体的风险偏好，并利用这些数据考察风险偏好对采用太阳能光伏系统决策的影响。我们的研究结果证实了我们的假设，即风险偏好在决定太阳能光伏采用的状态以及采用时机方面发挥着关键作用。我们的发现表明，在政策设计中降低风险，或通过风险缓释保险产品降低风险，有助于在家庭中推广太阳能光伏的采用。

Behavioral preferences and contract choice in the residential solar PV market
abstract: Greater adoption of renewable energy technologies by households is a key component of decarbonization and energy transition goals. Although existing literature has examined how sociodemographic characteristics, “green” preferences, and peer effects impact adoption of new energy technology, the role of behavioral preferences has not been adequately studied. In this paper, we examine the effect of two types of behavioral preferences, namely the degree of risk tolerance (risk preference) and attitude toward delayed reward (time preference) on the contract decision to lease or own a solar photovoltaic (PV) system. We develop a theoretical framework to show that the effect of risk and time preferences on the relative utilities from the two contracts is monotonic: Lower risk aversion and lower discount rate (more patience) imply a higher chance of solar PV ownership. To test these predictions empirically, we first estimate preference parameters (risk aversion and discount rate) from laboratory data collected from solar PV adopters. We then combine the parameter estimates with data on actual solar PV contract choice to examine the relationship between solar PV adopters' time and risk preferences and their lease‐versus‐own choice. Our regression results confirm that less risk averse individuals have a higher tendency to choose the ownership option, whereas more patient individuals are (weakly) more likely to own their solar PV systems. These findings contribute to a greater understanding of the role of behavioral factors in household decisions related to energy technologies.
abstract_zh: 家庭更广泛地采用可再生能源技术，是实现脱碳和能源转型目标的关键组成部分。尽管已有文献考察了社会人口特征、“绿色”偏好及同伴效应对新能源技术采用的影响，但行为偏好的作用尚未得到充分研究。本文考察了两类行为偏好，即风险容忍度（风险偏好）和对延迟回报的态度（时间偏好），对家庭在租赁或购买太阳能光伏系统之间做出合同选择的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，证明风险偏好和时间偏好对两种合同相对效用的影响是单调的：风险厌恶程度越低、贴现率越低（越有耐心），拥有光伏系统的可能性就越高。为了实证检验这些预测，我们首先利用从太阳能光伏采用者收集的实验室数据估计偏好参数（风险厌恶和贴现率），然后将参数估计值与实际光伏合同选择数据相结合，考察光伏采用者的时间偏好和风险偏好与其“租赁还是购买”选择之间的关系。回归结果证实，风险厌恶程度较低的个人更倾向于选择购买，而更有耐心的个人（弱）更可能拥有其光伏系统。这些发现有助于更好地理解行为因素在家庭能源技术决策中的作用。

title: Comparing designs for resource adequacy in laboratory electricity markets
My Neighbor Next Floor: The Built Environment and Social Preferences
abstract: We assess the effect of the built environment on low-cost helping behavior toward neighbors. The setting is communities in Shanghai, China that, due to rapid development, were involuntarily relocated to different building structures. Our natural field experiment accounts for potential misreporting, attrition, and interference. Treatment assignment avoids interference by design, and we develop a randomization test to account for the bias this introduces. Living one floor apart reduces the willingness to help a neighbor by 20 percentage points, as does adding one more apartment per floor. Small physical barriers can profoundly shape social interactions, and helping behavior, in urban settings.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了建成环境对邻里间低成本帮助行为的影响。研究背景是中国上海的一些社区，由于快速发展，居民被非自愿地迁往不同的建筑结构中。我们的自然现场实验考虑了潜在的误报、流失和干扰问题。处理分配在设计上避免了干扰，并且我们开发了一种随机化检验，以考虑由此引入的偏差。住在相隔一层的楼层，会使帮助邻居的意愿降低 20 个百分点；每层多一套住房也会产生同样的效果。在城市环境中，即使是很小的物理障碍，也能深刻地塑造社会互动和帮助行为。
